facts.value: The palm nuts are boiled for 20 minutes, crushed and washed, and the liquid strained

parts.text: Palm butter soup is one of the most common Liberian soups, made from the red outer flesh of the palm nut. A version published by UN Tourism cooks the boiled, crushed palm nut with smoked chicken, dried fish and pepper until the sauce thickens.
It is usually served with rice or a starchy side dish such as GB (geebee), a cassava food, and it is one of the traditional dishes found in Monrovia restaurants.
